business_problem: Facing a rapidly growing passenger base and rising traveler expectations, Air India needed to modernize its customer experience without increasing operational costs.
solution_summary: Air India used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Cosmos DB to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. Migrating workloads to Microsoft Azure and deploying Azure OpenAI Service enabled the creation of AI.g, a generative AI-powered virtual assistant that handles customer queries with speed, accuracy, and empathy.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves grounding context for assistants and search experiences.

solution_components.name: Azure Cosmos DB
solution_components.role: Persists low-latency application data, conversation state, or operational records.

solution_components.name: Azure App Service
solution_components.role: Hosts web applications and service endpoints without infrastructure management.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in Azure AI Search, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure Cosmos DB, and returned through Azure App Service to employees or customers with grounded responses.
business_outcome: Migrating workloads to Microsoft Azure and deploying Azure OpenAI Service enabled the creation of AI.g, a generative AI-powered virtual assistant that handles customer queries with speed, accuracy, and empathy.
metrics: Since its launch, AI.g has managed millions of interactions, automating 97% of them and freeing human agents to focus on complex cases.
